mapper.update: update t_msg_record set status = #{status} where msg_id = #{msgId}
update t_msg_record set retry_count = #{newCount} where msg_id = #{msgId}
mapper.select: select msg_id as msgId, source_id as sourceId, channel as channel, `to` as `to`, subject as subject, status as status, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from t_msg_record where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id desc limit #{limit}
select status, count(*) as cnt from t_msg_record where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and create_time >= #{since} group by status
select channel, count(*) as cnt from t_msg_record where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and create_time >= #{since} group by channel
select source_id as sourceId, count(*) as cnt from t_msg_record where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and create_time >= #{since} group by source_id
select count(*) from t_msg_record where tenant_id = #{tenantId}
